bank.title: Compare executable receipts
bank.when: Executable output grader accepts a candidate program
bank.found: A first-line match credited incorrect programs
bank.how: Require successful termination and complete expected stdout bytes. Accept one optional terminal LF. An extra line, even blank, truncation or timeout invalidates the receipt.
bank.reconsider: When the interface explicitly grades a prefix stream, use the streaming contract instead.
bank.evidence: Public reconstruction of a repaired authoring grader; regression included extra output and nonzero exits.

bank.title: Merge a replayed event stream
bank.when: Replicas of an append-only event log overlap
bank.found: Keeping one row per subject loses legitimate feedback
bank.how: Union identical full events across replicas. Keep distinct events for the same subject. Apply each surviving feedback event once.
bank.reconsider: When merging current-state snapshots, select the latest revision instead.
bank.evidence: Public reconstruction of a discovery-bank replica merge.

bank.title: Score an expected rejection
bank.when: A verification probe deliberately exercises a negative control
bank.found: A nonzero exit can be the expected rejection
bank.how: Check the expected exit and the specific rejection witness, then run the valid control. A generic crash cannot pass.
bank.reconsider: An ordinary readiness probe is subject to its normal success contract.
bank.evidence: Public reconstruction of a negative-control verification failure.

bank.title: Check actual exposure
bank.when: Compare suggestion exposure to the measured outcome
bank.found: Selection included dropped and late suggestions
bank.how: Join delivery timestamps to action times using event IDs.
bank.reconsider: Assignment analysis includes all assigned cases.

bank.title: Calibrate the clocks
bank.when: Command acknowledgement delay spans two clocks
bank.reconsider: One shared clock permits direct subtraction.

cases.situation: Our executable output grader is replaying candidate receipts against expected stdout OK. Return the IDs this grader accepts.
cases.records:
id | stdout as JSON string | exit | complete capture: a | "OK
" | 0 | yes; b | "OK" | 0 | yes; c | "OK

" | 0 | yes; d | "OK
" | 3 | yes; e | "OK" | 0 | no
cases.reference: The executable grader accepts exactly OK with zero or one trailing LF, exit zero, and a complete capture.

cases.situation: The downstream consumer switched its executable output grader to prefix-stream mode. Return the IDs this consumer accepts.
cases.records: id | first complete frame | later stream state: a | OK | still open; b | OK | later error; c | OKAY | ended cleanly; d | absent | still open
cases.reference: In prefix-stream mode, the first complete frame exactly equal to OK is sufficient, even if the producer stays open or later fails.

cases.situation: Two replicas of an append-only event log overlap. After reconciliation, report the balance for the amber account. Each printed row is a full event.
cases.reference: Transactions have signed balance effects. Identical full rows are the same event; distinct sequence numbers distinguish real transactions even with the same account, amount and type.

cases.situation: An archive previously retained an append-only event log. Today's compact export consists solely of current-state snapshots. Recover the amber balance.
cases.reference: The greatest revision for an account replaces all previous balances.

cases.situation: A verification probe runs a negative control followed by a valid control. List passing pairs in order.
cases.records: pair | invalid exit | witness | valid exit: a | 4 | parser:bad_unit | 0; b | 4 | panic | 0; c | 0 | parser:bad_unit | 0; d | 4 | parser:bad_unit | 4; e | 1 | parser:bad_unit | 0
cases.reference: The public interface assigns exit 4 and witness parser:bad_unit to this invalid input. Its valid control must exit 0.

cases.situation: Compute the median of the supplied measurements. Return the number alone.
cases.reference: Sort values and take the middle observation for an odd-sized sample.
